gavin newsom signed an executive order banning california state officials from betting on prediction markets using insider information. bipartisan bills in both the house and senate this week.
 
the momentum on this is real and it needs to be.

worth a try blaming war on israel pm, but president trump was and is the decisionmaker.

g7 foreign ministers meeting in france today. on the agenda: stop the war, end iran's nuclear program, reopen the strait of hormuz.
also on the agenda, implicitly: explain to allies why the us launched this war without telling them and ask them to help fix it.

four weeks in, iran continues to export oil through the strait of hormuz. 

1.5 million barrels a day, at significantly higher prices than before the war.

new trump deadline just dropped.

strait still near completely closed for next two weeks? yes.
trump with second delay on self-imposed deadline…now paused until us troops are expected to arrive in persian gulf.

“no way!”
“way.”


*Walter Bloomberg (@DeItaone)

RUBIO: HORMUZ COULD BE OPENED TOMORROW IF IRAN ALLOWED IT



— https://nitter.net/DeItaone/status/2037225459570606439#m

3.2 million internally displaced inside iran.
1 million in lebanon.
158,000 arrivals from lebanon into syria. 43,000 into turkey.

this is the humanitarian cost of war.

houthi leader tells reuters they stand ready to disrupt the bab-al-mandab strait—if iran calls on them.. 

reuters.com/world/middle-eas…

the oecd on the iran war's economic cost: us inflation jumping to 4.2%. global growth slowing to 2.9%. eurozone growth at 0.8%.
and that's before accounting for fertilizer shortages. the food price shock is still coming.
15,800 years of dogs putting up with humans. moose doing his part.
